settings.label: Exposure
settings.helpZH: 色调映射前的曝光。

settings.label: Auto exposure
settings.helpZH: 在基础曝光之上，按屏幕亮度缓慢调整；关闭后恢复原画面。

settings.label: Metering target
settings.helpZH: 线性画面的目标亮度，越大整体越亮。

settings.label: Adaptation strength
settings.helpZH: 亮度负幂曲线的指数；0 不调整，1 完全补偿测光差异。

settings.label: Exposure range (EV)
settings.helpZH: 相对基础画面允许的正负档数；1 档限制在 0.5 到 2 倍。

settings.label: Adaptation time
settings.helpZH: 适应亮处的时间常数（秒）；进入暗处时适应速度为其三倍。

settings.label: Sun strength
settings.helpZH: 太阳直射光强度。

settings.label: Environment reflection
settings.helpZH: 基于环境贴图的高光强度。

settings.label: Sun shadows
settings.helpZH: 两级缓存的太阳阴影。

settings.label: Sky boundary shadows
settings.help: Ignore sunlight blockers beyond sky blocks. Off skips entrance and interior shadow passes; the atlas layout is retained.
settings.helpZH: 排除天空方块外侧的太阳遮挡。关闭后跳过入口与内侧阴影绘制，保留原纹理布局。

settings.label: Shadow resolution
settings.helpZH: 每一级阴影图的尺寸。

settings.label: Shadow range
settings.help: Far shadow radius in blocks; the near cascade covers a quarter.
settings.helpZH: 远级阴影半径（格），近级为其四分之一。

settings.label: Shadow update interval
settings.help: Minimum seconds between changed shadow renders; 0 = every frame.
settings.helpZH: 阴影变化后两次重绘的最短间隔（秒），0 为每帧。

settings.label: Shadow strength
settings.helpZH: 只遮挡太阳直射光。

settings.label: Shadow bias
settings.help: Base receiver depth bias in blocks.
settings.helpZH: 接收面的基础深度偏移（格）。

settings.label: PBR water
settings.helpZH: 使用光影包的水面着色器。

settings.label: Water caustics
settings.helpZH: 独立控制焦散亮纹，不关闭水下丁达尔光柱。

settings.label: Ripples
settings.helpZH: 水面波纹强度。

settings.label: Refraction
settings.helpZH: 屏幕空间扭曲强度，0 为不扭曲。

settings.label: Absorption
settings.helpZH: 每格水的光吸收。

settings.label: Shore foam
settings.helpZH: 岸边的轻微泡沫。

settings.label: Underwater light shafts
settings.helpZH: 独立控制水下体积光，不关闭距离雾或焦散。

settings.label: Water reflections
settings.help: Screen-space reflections on water; needs an extra scene depth pass.
settings.helpZH: 水面屏幕空间反射，需要额外一次场景深度。

settings.label: Water reflection strength
settings.helpZH: 未命中处保留环境反射。

settings.label: Water ray length
settings.help: Maximum reflection ray length in blocks.
settings.helpZH: 反射射线最大长度（格）。

settings.label: Water ray steps
settings.helpZH: 射线步数上限。

settings.label: Block reflections
settings.help: Screen-space reflections on smooth blocks; redraws visible terrain once.
settings.helpZH: 光滑方块的屏幕空间反射，会多画一遍可见地形。

settings.label: Reflection roughness limit
settings.help: Roughness at which block reflections fade out.
settings.helpZH: 粗糙度达到此值时反射完全淡出。

settings.label: Block ray length
settings.help: Maximum reflection ray length in blocks.
settings.helpZH: 反射射线最大长度（格）。

settings.label: Block ray steps
settings.helpZH: 射线步数上限。

settings.label: Hit thickness
settings.help: Larger fills holes but widens near objects in reflections.
settings.helpZH: 调大可补空洞，但近处物体在反射里会被拉宽。

settings.label: Contact occlusion
settings.helpZH: 不透明表面的屏幕空间遮蔽。

settings.label: Radius
settings.helpZH: 采样半径（格）。

settings.label: Fade distance
settings.help: Fade occlusion beyond this distance in blocks.
settings.helpZH: 超过此距离（格）后淡出。

settings.label: Fog
settings.helpZH: 距离雾与高度雾。

settings.label: Distance fog density
settings.helpZH: 每格消光。

settings.label: Clear distance
settings.helpZH: 无雾前景距离（格）。

settings.label: Opaque distance
settings.help: Air fog reaches full opacity here, in blocks; 0 disables. At least one block beyond the clear distance.
settings.helpZH: 空气雾在此距离（格）达到完全不透明；0 关闭。实际值至少比清晰距离多 1 格。

settings.label: Height fog density
settings.help: Maximum height-fog extinction, constant at and below the base height.
settings.helpZH: 高度雾的最大消光，基准高度及以下保持此浓度。

settings.label: Height fog base
settings.help: Base height in MC world blocks.
settings.helpZH: MC 世界中的基准高度（格）。

settings.label: Height fog falloff
settings.help: Ascent above the base that halves the density, in blocks.
settings.helpZH: 基准面以上浓度减半所需的上升高度（格）。

settings.label: Integration distance
settings.helpZH: 大气计算的最大距离（格）。

settings.label: Light shafts
settings.help: Shadowed single-scattering sunlight; needs fog and shadows.
settings.helpZH: 带阴影的单次散射阳光，需要雾和阴影。

settings.label: Light shaft distance
settings.helpZH: 最大距离（格）。

settings.label: Bloom
settings.helpZH: 柔和的高光泛光。

settings.label: Threshold
settings.helpZH: 色调映射后的高光阈值。

settings.label: Soft knee
settings.helpZH: 阈值的柔和过渡宽度。

settings.label: Radius
settings.helpZH: 模糊半径倍数。
